en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy harbor with several docked ships and sailors on the pier in the foreground. Warehouses, piers, and smaller boats line the waterfront, while a town with many buildings and church domes spreads across the hillside in the background. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in Cyrillic and German identifying the view as Varna.
